text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and use human language. Unlike simple word matching, NLP focuses on the meaning behind text, including grammar, context, and even emotion. This technology powers machine translation, turning English into Japanese or French in seconds. It also drives sentiment analysis, which allows companies to see if customer reviews are positive, negative, or neutral. Perhaps most visibly, NLP makes chatbots possible. These virtual assistants can answer questions, book appointments, or offer support in a natural, conversational way. As NLP improves, our interactions with machines become more human-like and useful every day.
